ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe in? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe in.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe in.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe in.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Harmonious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Safe and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Safe Travel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Environmental and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
